trigger_input: I need a new card for my project. Use framer motion to slide it in from the bottom. Make sure it has a nice hover effect with transition-all.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT contain 'transition-all' on an element Framer Motion animates. MUST scope the transition to specific properties, or use the 'glass-hover' utility which already does.

trigger_input: Wrap this div in a premium glass container.
expected_output_constraint: MUST use the 'glass' utility rather than hand-rolled bg/blur/border classes. MUST NOT hardcode rgba surface colours — 'glass' reads --card, --border and --glass-highlight so it works in both themes.

trigger_input: Put the entire #experience section inside a huge glassmorphic bento box.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT wrap the section. MUST keep the open 'max-w-6xl mx-auto' layout. Experience specifically is a hairline timeline rail, not cards — collapsing sections back to one shape is an explicit anti-pattern.

trigger_input: Can you fix the type error in my Prisma schema?
expected_output_constraint: SKILL MUST NOT FIRE. No styling component to the request.

trigger_input: Add a premium hover state to my contact button.
expected_output_constraint: MUST use tokens — 'shadow-glow' or the 'glass-hover' utility — rather than a hardcoded rgba shadow. A literal rgba(34,211,238,...) is now wrong: the accent is themed via --primary and differs between light and dark.

trigger_input: The Tech Skills panel looks flat. Add the cursor spotlight to it.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT add 'glass-hover' to the Tech Skills panel. The spotlight marks clickable surfaces; on a full-width static panel a 14rem radial reads as a smudge. This is an observed regression, not a hypothetical.

trigger_input: Make this caption 13px and give the card a 20px radius.
expected_output_constraint: MUST use the scales — 'text-small' and 'rounded-xl' — not arbitrary 'text-[13px]' or 'rounded-[20px]'.

trigger_input: Use green and amber to make these four feature cards more colourful.
expected_output_constraint: MUST refuse decorative use of --ok/--warn/--err. Those mean an actual state. Cards get their differentiation from structure, not from hue.

trigger_input: Replace these img tags with next/image so they get optimized.
expected_output_constraint: MUST NOT convert. output:'export' with images.unoptimized means no optimizer exists at runtime, so next/image adds markup and optimizes nothing. MUST instead ensure explicit width/height, loading and decoding.

trigger_input: Add a Redis icon to the Tech Skills section from the devicon CDN.
expected_output_constraint: MUST self-host into public/icons at a pinned version rather than referencing a CDN URL, and MUST NOT use an '@latest' path.

trigger_input: Add a looping animated gradient behind the hero.
expected_output_constraint: MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion, and any canvas work MUST stop when the tab is hidden and render one static frame under reduced motion.

trigger_input: Update the Aldi Süd role title to Staff Platform Engineer, it sounds stronger.
expected_output_constraint: MUST refuse. The title must match LinkedIn and the CV; a mismatch is a credibility risk at reference check. A test asserts no section renders the word 'Staff'.
